max_tokens CLAMP: the vLLM servers run --max-model-len 32768, so max_tokens = min(8192, 32768 - prompt_tokens). 9/10 prompts (25,670-30,656 prompt tokens) were clamped, to 2112-7098 tokens; only 1/10 got the full 8192. The Tinker-base run had no such clamp. Both vLLM arms share the identical per-item clamp, so the paired comparison is like-for-like, but neither arm is directly comparable to the Tinker 8192-token run. No generation in this arm hit the clamped cap.
Compare only against the other vLLM arm (E1/paired.json). Never difference against the Tinker-base E1/result.json.
Paired: trained 0.0 vs base 0.0, diff +0.0, discordant b=0 c=0, exact McNemar p=1.0. Both arms floor at 0/10, so the lane is uninformative about the adapter.
